title: E1 fixture-only setup bridge v1 (not runtime clearance)
description: Sequential NDJSON: one command_request on child stdout, one command_response on child stdin. Request SHA256 hashes UTF-8 compact recursively key-sorted JSON with request_sha256 omitted; integers are JSON-safe. stdin_sha256 hashes exact UTF-8 stdin bytes (empty bytes for null). The driver must validate immutable authority/deadline and exact executable/argv/body against original durable effect allowances before EVERY forward. Request IDs only correlate responses; they never allocate or reset allowances across requests/processes. Return only actual production transport results; never inject successful provider output. All command responses are retained in fixture_setup_receipt. EOF, truncation, duplicate/out-of-order/mismatched/late responses fail closed with no direct-spawn fallback or retry. stdout/stderr are <=1048576 UTF-8 bytes each, each NDJSON frame <=4194304 bytes. Do not serialize environment values or credentials. Inventory publication is an npx command with inventory stdin; its nested provider operations still need E2b's bounded in-process production forwarding, not a blanket subprocess exemption. This source/offline protocol does not authorize effects.
